Priya: likely router lost parent_provisional on handoff. Quick mitigations: (A) router forward resume/parent headers (longer), (B) ledger: confirm-coalesce by prefix-hash within a 10s grace window, atomically confirm earliest and tombstone others with suppress_refund + merged_ids metadata, (C) console: collapse provisional rows and show "merged" badge. I recommend B+C as fast follow-through; router patch after.

Ken: agree. watch metrics: provisional_merge_rate, transient_confirm_rows, refunds_suppressed.
